signatures.capabilities: dnd character hud, hero sheet, hp hearts, xp progress, armor class, level display

events.name: ROLL
events.description: Dice request for the dice atom: initiative, attack, and damage rolls all flow through this single channel, purpose-tagged initiative:<id> / attack:<id> / damage:<id>

events.name: HERO_DAMAGE
events.description: Damage dealt to the hero unit; the hero-sheet atom applies it to hp and runs the 0-hp down path (crit doubles the death-save failures when the hero is already down)

events.name: DEATH_SAVE
events.description: A death-save d20 adjudicated by the hero-sheet atom; rolled organically by this atom (purpose deathsave) when the hero unit starts a turn at 0 hp

events.name: HERO_GAIN_XP
events.description: XP awarded to the hero when a monster is slain (the monster's xpValue); the hero-sheet atom levels on thresholds

events.name: MONSTER_SLAIN
events.description: A monster dropped to 0 hp and was removed from units + initiative; loot/quest listeners react

events.name: ATTACK_RESOLVED
events.description: An attack fully resolved (roll + damage applied); combat log and fx listeners render the outcome

events.name: TURN_STARTED
events.description: A side's turn began (hero player-turn or the monster queue); UI highlights the active side

events.name: UNIT_MOVED
events.description: A unit's grid position changed (hero MOVE or monster AI step); board renderers listen

events.name: UNIT_DASHED
events.description: The hero took the Dash action: movement refilled by speed, action spent; narrators/loggers listen

events.name: UNIT_DODGING
events.description: The hero took the Dodge action: attacks against them roll with disadvantage until their next turn; narrators/loggers listen

events.name: COMBAT_ENDED
events.description: Encounter over: won when the last monster died, lost on HERO_DIED; round-flow listeners route to victory/defeat

events.name: MONSTER_STEP
events.description: Internal hop that drives the monster queue one monster per transition; this atom listens to its own emit to chain the queue

events.name: DICE_ROLLED
events.description: A dice roll resolved: raw rolls, kept dice (after advantage/disadvantage), and the bonus-inclusive total; combat and hero mechanics listen

events.name: GENERATE_FLOOR
events.description: Delve intent: carve floor N (START_DELVE begins the run, DESCEND advances after a won encounter on the stairs)

events.name: ENCOUNTER_START
events.description: Encounter seed built from the generated floor: hero unit at heroSpawn plus monsters statted from the monsterStats roster, and the carved tiles for passability

events.name: MOVE
events.description: Hero move intent from a reachable-tile click; combat validates bounds/passability/moveLeft

events.name: ATTACK
events.description: Hero attack intent from a monster click; combat validates adjacency/team/action

events.name: TRAP_SPRUNG
events.description: The hero stepped onto an un-sprung trap tile; the hero sheet rolls the dex save

events.name: ROLL
events.description: Loot dice request when a chest is opened (purpose loot, 2d4+2 healing)

events.name: HERO_HEAL
events.description: Healing applied from an opened chest's loot roll

events.name: CHEST_LOOT
events.description: A chest was opened and yielded a healing draught of this amount; narrators listen

events.name: ESCAPED
events.description: The hero descended from the final floor — the delve is won and the epilogue is narrated

events.name: DASH
events.description: Dash action intent (sidebar button / D key), forwarded to the bus; combat spends the hero's action to refill movement

events.name: DODGE
events.description: Dodge action intent (sidebar button / G key), forwarded to the bus; attacks against the hero roll at disadvantage until their next turn

events.name: END_TURN
events.description: End-turn intent (sidebar button / Space), forwarded to the bus; combat hands initiative to the monster queue

events.name: FLOOR_GENERATED
events.description: A floor was carved and verified connected: the carved tile grid (passable count = array/len of the passable filter), monster spawn markers, hero spawn, the stairs-down feature, and the full feature list (stairs/chests/traps) so listeners can mirror it without cross-trait reads; the board builds combat's ENCOUNTER_START payload from this data

events.name: ROLL
events.description: Dice request for the dice atom: saving throws (purpose save:dex:trap) and trap damage (purpose trap:damage) roll through the shared dice channel

events.name: TRAP_SAVE
events.description: A trap dex-save adjudicated: success (total met the DC, no damage) or failure with the rolled damage; narrators and boards listen

events.name: HERO_DOWN
events.description: Hero dropped to 0 hp and is making death saves; combat listens to mark the hero unit and round-flow listens for the loss path

events.name: HERO_DIED
events.description: Hero accumulated 3 death-save failures and is dead; combat ends the encounter as lost

events.name: HERO_LEVELED
events.description: Hero crossed an XP threshold and leveled (proficiency recomputed per SRD); UI toasts and sheets listen

events.name: HERO_REVIVED
events.description: A death-save nat 20 revived the hero at 1 hp; combat restores the hero unit copy so normal turns resume

events.name: HERO_STABLE
events.description: Three death-save successes stabilized the hero at 0 hp; combat marks the unit stable and skips future death-save turns until he takes damage

events.name: OW_STEER

events.name: OW_LEAP
events.description: Renamed JUMP consumed by the open world's platformer-body authority (grounded-gated vertical kick).

events.name: OW_PLACE
events.description: Renamed PLACE consumed by the open world's platformer-body authority; respawn teleports (pit fall, life loss) and gate push-backs.

events.name: OW_DAMAGE
events.description: Damage bridge consumed by the lives authority (renamed DAMAGE); sources: fell, hazard tiles, patrol hits.

events.name: OW_FELL
events.description: Pit-fall signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_FELL); riya teleports to the lives authority's checkpoint and pays one life.

events.name: OW_HAZARD
events.description: Hazard-tile contact from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_HAZARD); bridged to OW_DAMAGE.

events.name: OW_PATROL_HIT
events.description: Patrol contact from the patrol-hazard authority (renamed PATROL_HIT); bridged to OW_DAMAGE with a 💥 burst.

events.name: OW_RESPAWN
events.description: Respawn point from the lives authority (renamed RESPAWN); forwarded to the body authority's PLACE.

events.name: OW_LIFE_LOST
events.description: A life was spent (renamed LIFE_LOST); 💔 burst + hearts HUD refresh.

events.name: OW_GAME_OVER
events.description: Last life spent (renamed GAME_OVER from the lives authority); the play trait shows the game-over overlay.

events.name: OW_GATE_BLOCKED
events.description: Player pressed against a closed star door (renamed GATE_BLOCKED); the play trait pushes riya back and floats the cost.

events.name: OW_GATE_OPENED
events.description: A star door's cost was reached (renamed GATE_OPENED); 🔓 burst.

events.name: OW_LOOP_UNLOCKED
events.description: A full revolution around the treasure ring was completed (renamed LOOP_UNLOCKED); the play trait spills the chest's five bonus gems.

events.name: OW_VG_OPENED
events.description: A velocity gate's speed band was satisfied — crossed in-band, or stillness held for the dwell (renamed VELOCITY_GATE_OPENED); the play trait spills five bonus gems around the gate.

events.name: OW_VG_DENIED
events.description: The player entered a closed velocity gate outside its band or against its direction (renamed VELOCITY_GATE_DENIED); the play trait pushes riya back and floats the gate's hint.

events.name: OW_CHOICE_WRONG
events.description: The player landed on a wrong option platform (renamed CHOICE_WRONG); the play trait bounces riya back to the approach and floats the gate's hint.

events.name: OW_CHOICE_CORRECT
events.description: The player landed on the correct option platform (renamed CHOICE_CORRECT); the gate is solved, the card dismisses, and the way to the reward cluster stays open.

events.name: OW_COEF_PAD_APPLIED
events.description: The player rode over an unapplied coefficient pad (renamed COEF_PAD_APPLIED); the play trait appends the mod to the body authority's curveMods (the road reshapes under the next tick), stamps the precomputed modded segment for render, and hops riya onto the lifted surface.

events.name: OW_CURVE_MOD_ADD
events.description: Mod-application intent routed to the body authority (renamed CURVE_MOD_ADD, the single ordered writer of curveMods); the play trait emits it from OW_COEF_PAD_APPLIED instead of writing the body's field.

events.name: OW_CURVE_MOD_CLEAR_RANGE
events.description: Range-scoped mod clear routed to the body authority (renamed CURVE_MOD_CLEAR_RANGE); the play trait emits it from OW_MOD_SINE_CLEAR so the sine quiz rebuilds only its own wave window.

events.name: OW_SET_TUNING
events.description: Tuning broadcast consumed by the platformer-body authority (renamed SET_TUNING); the play trait emits the world defaults on every zone change so zone-local power-ups revert on zone exit.

events.name: OW_COEF_PAD_SET_COMPLETED
events.description: Every coefficient pad applied (renamed COEF_PAD_SET_COMPLETED); the card dismisses and the completion burst fires. Grants no gems — the reward is access to the relocated stars.

events.name: OW_PAD_GROUP_COMPLETED
events.description: One pad group fully lit (renamed PAD_GROUP_COMPLETED); the play trait floats a Σ row-complete burst. Later groups stay dead until the lowest uncompleted group finishes.

events.name: OW_PAD_SET_COMPLETED
events.description: Every pad in the world lit (renamed PAD_SET_COMPLETED); the play trait spills five bonus gems around riya.

events.name: OW_AREA_FILLED
events.description: A fill region's painted area reached its target (renamed AREA_FILLED); the play trait spills five bonus gems around riya at the completion point.

events.name: OW_CARD_DISMISS
events.description: Mechanic-progress broadcast (pad group/set, velocity gate, area fill, loop ring) that clears the zone card early — the card authority owns the shared card field, so dismissal routes through its CARD_DISMISS listen.

events.name: OW_ZONE_CHANGED
events.description: The player crossed into a different zone; the play trait swaps the HUD chip, skate equation and guides, fires the name banner, and the zone card holds name + concept + objective under the HUD until its ttl.

events.name: OW_CHECKPOINT
events.description: A zone-entry checkpoint was crossed (renamed CHECKPOINT_REACHED); 🚩 burst, respawn moved.

events.name: OW_SLOPE
events.description: Skate slope crossed a 0.5 bucket (renamed SLOPE_CHANGED); refreshes the HUD dy/dx chip.

events.name: OW_COLLECT
events.description: Running star total emitted by the pickup authority on every pickup (renamed COLLECT); the gate-lock authority opens doors whose cost it reaches and the play trait mirrors it into score.

events.name: OW_SET_FEATURES
events.description: Full collectible-set replacement consumed by the pickup authority (renamed SET_FEATURES); emitted by the merger at world assembly and by the play trait on replay.

events.name: OW_ADD_FEATURES

events.name: OW_SKATE_ON
events.description: Skate-engage signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_SKATE_START); riya touched a graph — fires the current zone's equation fx burst.

events.name: OW_SKATE_OFF
events.description: Skate-release signal from the platformer-body authority (renamed BODY_SKATE_END); clears the HUD slope chip.

events.name: OW_RESTART
events.description: Reseed broadcast consumed by every composed authority (body, gate, particles, patrols, lives, locks, trail, probe).

events.name: RIYA_WORLD_FAILED
events.description: Broadcast when the lives authority spends the last life; the overlay authority (RiyaOwClear) shows the game-over menu.

events.name: OW_TUT_SHOW
events.description: Renamed SHOW consumed by the tutorial overlay authority (re-opens the GIF tutorial from step one).

events.name: OW_BURST
events.description: Particle batch spawned on star pickup, zone entry, skate engage, damage, doors, checkpoints; fx-particles fades it.

events.name: OW_PROGRESS
events.description: Sparse progress signal emitted by the play trait on every pickup-authority OW_PICKED; the objective-flow gate resolves won from it.

events.name: OW_GAME_END
events.description: Win-gate resolution from the objective-flow authority (renamed GAME_END); won clears the open world.

events.name: RIYA_WORLD_SOLVED
events.description: Every ★ on the whole line captured — the win gate resolved won (guarded by celebrated so the gate's repeated GAME_ENDs fire it once).

events.name: DEMO_CANCEL
events.description: Real keyboard/d-pad input received; the composed autodemo atom stops its scripted replay and returns control to the player.

events.name: OW_PREVIEW_SEED

events.name: LEARN_STEP
events.description: One step of the transport clock or Step button (from the composed std-learn-transport trait); advances the planet by one equal-time, equal-area interval, confirming Kepler's second law.

events.name: LEARN_RESET
events.description: Transport Reset broadcast (from the composed std-learn-transport trait); returns the planet to perihelion (theta = 0) without changing eccentricity or axis.

events.name: LEARN_UPDATED
events.description: Transport state broadcast on load and Run/Pause toggle (from the composed std-learn-transport trait); repaints the full shell so the strip's Run/Pause label and step caption stay fresh.

events.name: SIM_3D_UPDATED

events.description: Transport Reset broadcast (from the composed std-learn-transport trait); returns the star to its first life-cycle stage.

events.name: LEARN_STEP
events.description: One step of the transport clock or Step button (from the composed std-learn-transport trait); advances plate motion by one step and recomputes landforms, earthquakes, and geometry — the same computation the tick used to run — and caps at maxAdvanceSteps.

events.name: LEARN_RESET
events.description: Transport Reset broadcast (from the composed std-learn-transport trait); reseeds boundary selection, advance progress, and motion geometry from config.

events.name: PLATES_3D_UPDATED

events.synonyms: subduction, tectonic plates, trench, convection, convergent, 3d

events.name: SYNC_STATIONS
events.description: Roster hot-swap relay into the composed Learn3DTour atom — STEP emits the newly selected preset's stations/edges/backdrop here so the tour trait (single writer of the roster and progress fields) adopts them and restarts the tour at the first new station.
events.synonyms: subduction, tectonic plates, trench, convection, convergent, 3d

events.name: MODE_SELECTED

events.name: TOUR_3D_UPDATED

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.description: Learner attached a morpheme from the bank to the right edge of the growing word; the attachment is judged against the order and category constraints.

events.name: REMOVE
events.description: Learner removed the most recently attached morpheme from the word.

events.name: CHECK_WORD
events.description: Learner asked whether the built sequence is an attested word; the concatenated forms are looked up in the gloss table.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner cleared the word back to empty, removing every attached morpheme.

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: APPLY_CHANGE
events.description: Learner applied the next ordered sound-change rule, striking every word whose current vowel matches it.

events.name: RESET_CHANGES
events.description: Learner reset all words back to their original vowels, undoing every applied rule.

events.name: SYNTAXTREE_UPDATED

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: RESET_TREE
events.description: Learner reset the current sentence's parse tree back to just the words, clearing all built constituents.

events.name: NEXT_SENTENCE
events.description: Learner advanced to the next sentence in the roster, resetting the parse tree.

events.name: CONDITIONING_UPDATED
events.description: The conditioning state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: conditioning update, associative strength, acquisition, extinction, trial result

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: RUN_PAIRING
events.description: Learner ran a CS+US pairing trial, driving associative strength toward the asymptote via the Rescorla-Wagner acquisition rule.

events.name: RUN_CS_ALONE
events.description: Learner ran a CS-alone trial, driving associative strength toward zero via the Rescorla-Wagner extinction rule.

events.name: RESET_TRIALS
events.description: Learner reset the trial history — associative strength, trial count, and phase all return to their starting values.

events.name: MEMORY_UPDATED
events.description: The memory state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: forgetting curve, retention, memory decay, Ebbinghaus, spaced repetition

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: ADD_REPETITION
events.description: Learner reviewed the material again — retention recovers a fraction of the forgotten gap (full boost spaced, half boost massed) and the decay clock restarts.

events.name: STEP_TIME
events.description: Advanced time by one twentieth of the horizon, decaying retention exponentially.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner reset the forgetting curve — retention, time, and repetition count return to their starting values.

events.name: OPERANT_UPDATED
events.description: The operant state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: operant conditioning, reinforcement schedule, cumulative record, Skinner, scallop, instrumental conditioning

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: EMIT_RESPONSE
events.description: Learner emitted a burst of responses (a lever-press batch); ratio schedules count the responses, interval schedules count the elapsed time, and either may make a reinforcer available.

events.name: DELIVER_REINFORCER
events.description: Learner collected the available reinforcer — a post-reinforcement pause flattens the cumulative record (the scallop) and variable schedules pick their next target.

events.name: SET_SCHEDULE
events.description: Learner switched the reinforcement schedule (fr, vr, fi, vi); progress toward the next reinforcer restarts.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner reset the cumulative record — responses, reinforcers, and elapsed time return to their starting values.

events.name: SIGNAL_UPDATED
events.description: The signal-detection state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: signal detection, SDT, d prime, criterion, hit rate, false alarm, ROC point, sensitivity, response bias

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: SET_CRITERION
events.description: Learner dragged the decision criterion; the theoretical hit and false-alarm rates recompute and the empirical counters re-anchor to zero.

events.name: RUN_TRIALS
events.description: Ran a batch of simulated detection trials at the configured base rate — each trial draws evidence from the noise or signal+noise distribution and scores a hit or false alarm against the criterion.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner reset the instrument — criterion, theoretical rates, and empirical counters return to their starting values.

events.name: STROOP_UPDATED
events.description: The Stroop scoring state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: stroop, stroop effect, interference, incongruent trial, cognitive control, selective attention

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: ANSWER_COLOR
events.description: Learner named the ink color of the current word; scored against the stimulus's inkName, bucketed by congruence.

events.name: NEXT_TRIAL
events.description: Advanced to the next stimulus, steered by congruentRatio: when the running congruent fraction exceeds the target, the next trial is drawn from the incongruent pool.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner reset the session — trial counters, accuracies, interference, and feedback return to their starting values.

stages.description: A vast cloud of gas and dust collapses under its own gravity, and a protostar begins to glow at its center.
stages.label: Nebula

stages.description: Hydrogen fuses into helium in the core, and the star shines steadily for billions of years — this is where our Sun is now.
stages.label: Main Sequence

stages.description: The core runs out of hydrogen and contracts while the outer layers swell and cool into a huge red envelope.
stages.label: Red Giant

stages.description: The outer layers drift away as a planetary nebula, leaving behind a hot, dense stellar remnant that slowly cools and fades.
stages.label: White Dwarf

stages.description: A vast cloud of gas and dust collapses under its own gravity, forming a protostar far more massive than the Sun.
stages.label: Nebula

stages.description: The star burns through hydrogen far faster than a Sun-like star, shining bright blue-white.
stages.label: Main Sequence

stages.description: Heavier elements fuse in shells around an iron core, until fusion can no longer release energy.
stages.label: Red Supergiant

stages.description: The core collapses in an instant and rebounds, blasting the star's outer layers into space in a brilliant explosion.
stages.label: Supernova

stages.description: The crushed core survives as an ultra-dense sphere of neutrons, often spinning rapidly as a pulsar.
stages.label: Neutron Star

stages.description: A vast cloud of gas and dust collapses under its own gravity, forming an extremely massive protostar.
stages.label: Nebula

stages.description: The star burns its fuel at a furious rate, glowing intensely blue and living only a few million years.
stages.label: Main Sequence

stages.description: The star swells into an enormous, luminous supergiant while fusing progressively heavier elements in its core.
stages.label: Blue Supergiant

stages.description: The iron core collapses catastrophically and the star detonates, briefly outshining an entire galaxy.
stages.label: Supernova

stages.description: Gravity overwhelms every other force, and the collapsed core forms a black hole from which not even light can escape.

default.caption: A phospholipid bilayer studded with proteins that forms the cell's outer boundary, enclosing everything you see here. It is selectively permeable, controlling which substances enter and leave.
default.name: Cell Membrane

default.caption: The cell's control center, enclosing most of its DNA within a double membrane. It directs growth and reproduction by regulating gene expression.
default.name: Nucleus

default.caption: A dense region inside the nucleus where ribosomal RNA is transcribed and ribosome subunits are assembled. Cells with high protein output have prominent nucleoli.
default.name: Nucleolus

default.caption: The powerhouse of the cell — its folded inner membrane hosts cellular respiration, converting nutrients into ATP. A typical animal cell carries hundreds.
default.name: Mitochondrion

default.caption: One of many mitochondria scattered through the cytosol; they cluster where energy demand is highest. Each carries its own small circular DNA.
default.name: Mitochondrion

default.caption: Mitochondria constantly divide and fuse, and damaged ones are recycled by lysosomes. Muscle cells pack thousands to sustain contraction.
default.name: Mitochondrion

default.caption: Flattened membrane sacs studded with ribosomes, continuous with the nuclear envelope. It folds and quality-checks proteins destined for secretion or membranes.
default.name: Rough ER

default.caption: Tubular membranes lacking ribosomes that synthesize lipids and steroids. It also detoxifies drugs and stores calcium ions for signaling.
default.name: Smooth ER

default.caption: A stack of flattened cisternae that modifies, sorts, and packages proteins arriving from the ER into vesicles — the cell's shipping department.
default.name: Golgi Apparatus

default.caption: Tiny RNA-protein machines that translate messenger RNA into polypeptide chains. They drift free in the cytosol or stud the rough ER.
default.name: Ribosomes

default.caption: A vesicle packed with hydrolytic enzymes that digest worn-out organelles and engulfed material. Its acidic interior keeps the enzymes safely contained.
default.name: Lysosome

default.caption: A pair of barrel-shaped microtubule arrays near the nucleus. They organize the spindle fibers that pull chromosomes apart during cell division.
default.name: Centrioles

default.caption: A small vesicle that breaks down fatty acids and neutralizes toxic hydrogen peroxide, converting it into water and oxygen.
default.name: Peroxisome

default.caption: Two polynucleotide strands wind around each other in a right-handed double helix, about ten base pairs per full turn. The rungs are the base pairs; the rails are the sugar-phosphate backbones.
default.name: Overall Helix

default.caption: Each rung pairs a purine with a pyrimidine: A with T (two hydrogen bonds) or G with C (three). Complementary pairing is what lets DNA copy itself faithfully.
default.name: One Base Pair

default.caption: The two outer rails are alternating deoxyribose sugars and phosphate groups, joined by phosphodiester bonds. The strands run antiparallel — one 5'→3', the other 3'→5'.
default.name: Sugar-Phosphate Backbone

default.caption: Because the two backbones are not exactly opposite each other, the helix has a wide major groove and a narrow minor groove. Transcription factors read base sequences mainly from the major groove.
default.name: Major & Minor Grooves

default.caption: Reactants: hydroxide (Nu⁻) and bromomethane. The C–Br bond is intact and the methyl group is tetrahedral — three H atoms umbrella away from bromine.
default.name: Reactants

default.caption: Approach: the nucleophile closes in from the backside — directly opposite the C–Br bond, along the σ* antibonding axis. Backside attack is what forces the inversion to come.
default.name: Backside Approach

default.caption: Transition state ‡: carbon is trigonal-bipyramidal — the Nu···C bond is half-formed and the C···Br bond half-broken (partial bonds drawn pale), and the three H atoms flatten into a plane perpendicular to the reaction axis.
default.name: Transition State ‡

default.caption: Products: the C–Br bond has broken and the Nu–C bond is fully formed. The hydrogen umbrella has flipped through the planar transition state — Walden inversion of configuration, the geometry 2D cannot show.
default.name: Products

default.caption: Departure: bromide, the leaving group, drifts away with the bonding electron pair; methanol stands with inverted geometry — the mirror-image arrangement of the reactant.
default.name: Departure

derivation.evidence: A determiner (Det) and a noun (N) combine into a Noun Phrase — here the subject "The cat".
A determiner (Det) and a noun (N) combine into a Noun Phrase — here the object "the mouse".
A verb (V) and its object Noun Phrase combine into a Verb Phrase — "chased the mouse".
The subject Noun Phrase and the Verb Phrase combine into the full Sentence.
A determiner (Det) and a noun (N) combine into a Noun Phrase — here the subject "A dog".
A determiner (Det) and a noun (N) combine into a Noun Phrase — here the object of the preposition, "the mat".
A preposition (P) and its Noun Phrase combine into a Prepositional Phrase — "on the mat".
A verb (V) and its Prepositional Phrase combine into a Verb Phrase — "sat on the mat".
The subject Noun Phrase and the Verb Phrase combine into the full Sentence.

derivation.evidence: A bare noun (N) alone forms a Noun Phrase — the subject "Birds".

knobDefs.synonyms: syllogism mood, proposition types, categorical syllogism, A E I O

knobDefs.label: Premises
knobDefs.description: The two premise propositions in categorical form, displayed above the diagram; the learner shades and marks regions for each.
knobDefs.synonyms: premise, universal affirmative, particular affirmative, all are, some are, categorical proposition

knobDefs.label: Term Labels
knobDefs.description: Display label for each term (subject S, middle M, predicate P); keys must match the circle ids.
knobDefs.synonyms: subject term, middle term, predicate term, minor term, major term

knobDefs.label: Regions
knobDefs.description: The seven interior regions of the three-circle diagram: the ✕-marker position, the button label, and the boolean definition (inside = circles whose intersection forms the region, outside = circles subtracted) that drives true lens shading.
knobDefs.synonyms: venn region, intersection, overlap, lens, venn diagram

knobDefs.label: Shaded Region Color
knobDefs.description: Fill color of a region the learner has shaded (claimed empty).

knobDefs.label: Show Solution
knobDefs.description: Append the solution's explanatory note to the verdict after a correct Test Validity.

default.note: Shading all of M outside P and marking S∩M forces the ✕ into S∩M∩P — so some S are P.

knobDefs.label: Solution
knobDefs.description: The shading and ✕ marks the premises demand, whether the syllogism is valid, and an explanatory note revealed by Show Solution.
knobDefs.synonyms: answer key, correct diagram, validity verdict, venn test solution

knobDefs.label: Strict Boolean Standpoint
knobDefs.description: Boolean standpoint: universal premises have no existential import, so the ✕ marks must match the solution exactly. When false (Aristotelian), only the shading must match.
knobDefs.synonyms: boolean standpoint, aristotelian standpoint, existential import

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Title shown above the instrument.

knobDefs.label: Challenge Mode
knobDefs.description: When true, propagation reveals no values until the learner has locked in an output prediction.
knobDefs.synonyms: predict first, quiz mode, prediction challenge

default.label: Circuit 1 — (A AND B) XOR (A OR B)

knobDefs.label: Circuits
knobDefs.description: Roster of circuits; each declares its input pins, gates in topological evaluation order, the wires (from/to node ids), and the gate whose value lights the output bulb. The layered graph layout computes node positions — circuits do not declare x/y.
knobDefs.synonyms: boolean circuit, logic gate, wiring diagram, gate network, digital logic

knobDefs.label: Gate Kinds
knobDefs.description: The gate vocabulary used by the circuits: AND and OR combine two inputs, NOT inverts one, XOR is true when its inputs differ.
knobDefs.synonyms: AND gate, OR gate, NOT gate, XOR gate, conjunction, disjunction, negation, exclusive or, logic gate

knobDefs.label: Height
knobDefs.description: Canvas height in pixels.

knobDefs.label: Input Count
knobDefs.description: How many of each circuit's input pins get toggle buttons.

knobDefs.label: Match Mode
knobDefs.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

knobDefs.label: Show Intermediate Values
knobDefs.description: After propagation, label and color every gate with its computed value; when false only the output bulb is revealed.

knobDefs.label: Fallacy Set
knobDefs.description: The classification categories offered as pick buttons and drawn as the stacked backdrop tiers; value is the machine key, label and color are what the learner sees.
knobDefs.synonyms: fallacy, ad hominem, straw man, false dilemma, affirming the consequent, informal fallacy, valid argument

default.explanation: It attacks the person rather than the argument — ad hominem.
default.hint: Does this engage the plan, or the person?
default.text: You're only against the plan because you never liked me.

default.explanation: It presents two extremes as the only possibilities — false dilemma.
default.hint: Are those really the only two options?
default.text: We either ban all cars or accept choking smog forever.

default.explanation: From P→Q and Q it concludes P — affirming the consequent.
default.hint: Can the match be cancelled for another reason?
default.text: If it rains, the match is cancelled. The match is cancelled, so it rained.

default.explanation: It exaggerates the position into something easier to attack — straw man.
default.hint: Is that really what he argued?
default.text: He wants the library closed? Next he'll want books banned.

default.explanation: The conclusion follows necessarily from the premises — a valid argument.
default.hint: Does the conclusion follow from the premises?
default.text: All mammals breathe air. Whales are mammals, so whales breathe air.

knobDefs.label: Corpus
knobDefs.description: Argument cards (text, correct classification, hint, explanation) presented one at a time; category must be one of the categories values.
knobDefs.synonyms: argument card, corpus, exercise set, fallacy example, argument

knobDefs.label: Allow Model Edit
knobDefs.description: When true the learner can toggle object predicates to change the model; when false the toggle buttons render but edits are ignored.
knobDefs.synonyms: editable model, change the model, flip truth value

knobDefs.label: Domain
knobDefs.description: The finite domain of objects (position, label, and the predicate keys each object has); toggling a predicate on an object changes the model.
knobDefs.synonyms: domain of discourse, model, object, individual, universe of discourse

knobDefs.label: Height
knobDefs.description: Canvas height in pixels.

knobDefs.label: Match Mode
knobDefs.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

knobDefs.label: Predicates
knobDefs.description: The property vocabulary (key, label, ring color); each predicate an object has is drawn as a colored ring around it.
knobDefs.synonyms: predicate, property, unary relation, monadic predicate

knobDefs.label: Show Truth Values
knobDefs.description: After a statement is evaluated, show its computed T/F beside it.

knobDefs.label: Statements
knobDefs.description: Quantified statements evaluated against the model: FORALL px (every object has px), EXISTS px (some object has px), FORALL_EXISTS px py (if any object has px then some object has py).
knobDefs.synonyms: universal quantifier, existential quantifier, for all, there exists, quantified statement, predicate logic

knobDefs.label: Band Cues
knobDefs.description: Per-band cues for ESTIMATE_JUDGED — one row per error band (exact/close/off); bands with no row spawn nothing.

knobDefs.label: Celebration Cue
knobDefs.description: Cue spawned when a round completes (LEARN_ROUND_COMPLETE / TRACE_DONE).

knobDefs.label: Correct Cue
knobDefs.description: Cue spawned on a correct judged answer.

knobDefs.label: Progress Cue
knobDefs.description: Cue spawned on a partial arrangement check (some but not all slots correct).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When false every cue arm is inert — visual feedback fully disabled without unmounting.

knobDefs.label: Streak Cue
knobDefs.description: Extra cue layered on the correct cue once the streak reaches the threshold.

knobDefs.label: Streak Threshold
knobDefs.description: Minimum ANSWER_JUDGED streak that adds the streak cue on top of the correct cue.

knobDefs.label: Verdict Cues
knobDefs.description: Per-verdict cues for CLASSIFY_UPDATED — one row per verdict string; verdicts with no row spawn nothing.

knobDefs.label: Wrong Cue
knobDefs.description: Cue spawned on a wrong judged answer (and an unmatched goal check).

knobDefs.label: Decay Rate
knobDefs.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.

knobDefs.label: Initial Fx
knobDefs.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.

knobDefs.label: First Term
knobDefs.description: The first term a₀, used by both the arithmetic and geometric formulas.
knobDefs.synonyms: first term, initial term, a0

knobDefs.label: Common Difference
knobDefs.description: The constant step d added per term in arithmetic mode.
knobDefs.synonyms: common difference, step

knobDefs.label: Preset
knobDefs.description: Which sequence formula generates each term: "arithmetic" (aₙ = a₀ + n·d) or "geometric" (aₙ = a₀·rⁿ).
knobDefs.synonyms: preset, sequence type, arithmetic, geometric

knobDefs.label: Common Ratio
knobDefs.description: The constant multiplier r applied per term in geometric mode.
knobDefs.synonyms: common ratio, ratio, growth factor

knobDefs.label: Term Count
knobDefs.description: Total number of terms in the sequence; Step is done once all terms are revealed.

knobDefs.label: Y Min

knobDefs.label: Line A Pivot Y

knobDefs.label: Line B Pivot X

knobDefs.label: Line B Pivot Y
knobDefs.description: Y coordinate of the fixed point line B always passes through.

knobDefs.label: Line A Slope Max
knobDefs.description: Upper bound of line A's slope.

knobDefs.label: Line A Slope Min
knobDefs.description: Lower bound of line A's slope; Step wraps back here after exceeding slopeAMax.

knobDefs.label: Line B Slope

knobDefs.label: Step Size
knobDefs.description: Signed integer hop applied to the marker on each Step; negative values hop left.
knobDefs.synonyms: step size, hop size, increment, delta

knobDefs.label: X Max
knobDefs.description: Right edge of the number line, in integer units.

knobDefs.label: X Min
knobDefs.description: Left edge of the number line, in integer units.

knobDefs.label: Y Max

knobDefs.description: Angular frequency k of y = A·sin(kx − φ); higher values compress the wave horizontally.

knobDefs.label: Sample Count
knobDefs.description: Number of x samples used to draw each curve between xMin and xMax.

knobDefs.label: Radius
knobDefs.description: Radius of the circle in data coordinates; scales cosθ and sinθ projections proportionally.
knobDefs.synonyms: radius, r

knobDefs.label: Sample Count
knobDefs.description: Number of points sampled around the circle to draw its outline.

knobDefs.label: Y Max

knobDefs.description: Angle in radians B rotates by on each Step (default 15°).

knobDefs.description: Fixed y component of vector A.

knobDefs.description: Which algebraic form the equation readout shows: standard ax² + bx + c, vertex a(x − h)² + k, or factored a(x − r₁)(x − r₂).

knobDefs.label: Sample Xs

knobDefs.label: Show Discriminant

knobDefs.label: Convergence Threshold
knobDefs.description: How close the secant slope must be to the tangent slope before the narration claims convergence.
knobDefs.synonyms: epsilon, tolerance, convergence

knobDefs.description: Which function the point rides: ½x², 0.1x³, or 3·sin(x). The tangent uses its analytic derivative.

knobDefs.label: Initial x
knobDefs.description: Starting x coordinate of the point of tangency.

knobDefs.label: Sample Xs

knobDefs.synonyms: derivative curve, f prime, derived function

knobDefs.label: Show Secant
knobDefs.description: Draw the secant line through x and x + h alongside the tangent.
knobDefs.synonyms: secant line, average rate of change

knobDefs.label: Lower Bound

knobDefs.label: Match Mode
knobDefs.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

knobDefs.label: Max Rectangles

knobDefs.label: Riemann Rule
knobDefs.description: Which rectangle rule the accumulation starts with: left endpoint, right endpoint, midpoint, or trapezoid.

knobDefs.label: Sample Xs
knobDefs.description: X coordinates the function is sampled at to draw its curve.

knobDefs.label: Show Exact Area

knobDefs.label: Upper Bound

knobDefs.label: Match Mode
knobDefs.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

knobDefs.label: Initial Matrix

knobDefs.label: Camera
knobDefs.description: 3D camera pose; the view is user-rotatable, so azimuth only sets the starting angle onto the vector scene.

knobDefs.label: Match Mode
knobDefs.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

knobDefs.description: Post stack as data; empty disables post-processing.

knobDefs.label: Scalar

knobDefs.label: Bodies

default.text: Grabbing a granola bar because you haven't eaten anything since breakfast yesterday.
Stocking the pantry with canned goods before a winter storm hits.
Installing a deadbolt lock after a break-in two doors down.
Negotiating a long-term contract instead of freelance gigs, for steady income.
Joining a weekly book club to make new friends in a new city.
Calling an old friend just to catch up and feel connected.
Working extra hours to earn the promotion and the recognition that comes with it.
Entering a competition to prove your skill to your peers.
Taking a sabbatical to finally write the novel you've always wanted to write.
Learning a new instrument purely for the joy of mastering it.

knobDefs.label: Income Weights
knobDefs.description: Relative income multiplier for each of the five strata, index-aligned with Strata (same order: richest to poorest). Used with the current shares to compute the Gini-style inequality index: income_i = share_i × weight_i, normalized into income shares, then the discrete Gini formula over cumulative population vs. cumulative income (poorest to richest).
knobDefs.synonyms: income distribution, income inequality, Gini index, Gini coefficient, wealth gap, economic inequality

default.explanation: C. Wright Mills: one person out of work is a personal trouble to be solved by that person's character and skills. When millions are out of work at once because factories close and whole job categories are automated away, the job market itself has broken down — that's a public issue rooted in economic structure, not individual failing.

options.label: He just isn't trying hard enough to get hired.
Structural unemployment — factories closing and jobs being automated away are eliminating entire categories of work across the economy.
Employers today are only looking for young talent.

default.troubleText: I can't find a job no matter how hard I try — it must be something wrong with me.

default.explanation: When only a few marriages fail, look to the couple. When divorce rates climb across an entire society within the same few years, the institution of marriage itself is under structural strain — a public issue, not a private failing.

options.label: A generation-wide collapse of the economic and social supports that used to hold marriages together.
She should have picked a better partner.
Marriage counseling just doesn't work anymore.

default.troubleText: My marriage is falling apart, and it feels like it's entirely my fault.

default.explanation: One student in debt is a private trouble. A whole generation carrying record debt loads, at the same time public funding for education has been withdrawn, is a public issue built into how college gets paid for.

options.label: He shouldn't have gone to such an expensive school.
People today just don't budget carefully enough.
A structural shift that moved the cost of higher education from public funding onto individual borrowers, across an entire generation.

default.troubleText: I'm drowning in student debt and can't seem to get ahead, no matter what I do.

default.explanation: A single burned-out worker is a personal trouble. When burnout tracks a structural shift toward insecure, boundary-less work across millions of workers at once, it's a public issue in how work itself has been reorganized.

options.label: She needs to manage her stress better.
An economy-wide shift toward precarious, always-on gig and contract work that has eroded job security for millions.
Some people just aren't cut out for a demanding career.

default.troubleText: I feel completely burned out and anxious all the time at work, and I don't know why I can't handle it like everyone else.

knobDefs.label: Material Recipes
knobDefs.description: How each named material renders, as a data-driven `draw-mesh` `material` preset resolved against the chosen palette's steps (a color reference like magic's `emissive: 'highlight'` names a palette step, not a literal hex): PBR kind (standard | physical | toon | basic) plus its knobs — metalness/roughness for metal, transmission/ior for crystal glass, an emissive-driven glow for magic, flatShading for stone's faceted low-poly look, and an outline width for toon's inverted-hull line.

knobDefs.label: Motion Timing
knobDefs.description: Animation personality: loop durations per anim state, one-shot (death/collapse) duration, flame-flicker cycle, idle/walk bob amplitude in cell units, and the full-turn spin constant. Loop keyframes must start and end on the same values.

knobDefs.label: Color Palettes
knobDefs.description: Master 5-step value scales plus drop-shadow RGBA strings per palette kind.

knobDefs.label: Post Presets
knobDefs.description: Per-style post-process preset — bloom ({ intensity, threshold, smoothing }) and vignette ({ offset, darkness }) — applied only where the style calls for it; neon leans on both for its glow, every other style ships empty (post stays off by default).

knobDefs.label: Proportion Grid
knobDefs.description: The 0..1 cell-box grid every asset sits on: feet/base end at groundLine, the ground drop shadow is an ellipse at shadowBand, unit body mass centers at bodyCenterY, heads read large (headRatio of body height — chibi readability), and an asset never exceeds maxLayers draw layers.

knobDefs.label: Lighting Rig
knobDefs.description: Per-style lighting preset shaped like the canvas `lighting` prop: ambient (flat fill light), directional (the shaped key light + its `position` in cells), hemisphere (sky/ground bounce tint), and an environment preset name ('room' | 'none') for PBR reflections. Style branches read here instead of hardcoding lights — glossy and low-poly run the full room rig, flat/cartoon/neon drop the environment and dial the directional key down or up for their look.

knobDefs.label: Shape Language
knobDefs.description: Personality → geometry mapping (circles read friendly, squares stable, triangles dangerous): pick the dominant shape family per roster role before authoring. Round = ellipses + soft curves; angular = triangles + sharp path corners; square = rects + flat tops; radial = concentric ellipses.

knobDefs.label: Style Direction
knobDefs.description: The theme direction token for the whole 3D art bible — the recipe branch every material/mesh molecule renders the same geometry+palette through: glossy PBR house style (metalness/roughness + a room environment + a soft directional key), pure minimal flat (basic unlit fills, weak directional, no environment), heavy-outline cartoon (bright ambient + an inverted-hull toon outline), neon (dim ambient, bloom + vignette post, emissive-driven materials), or low-poly (glossy's rig with `flatShading` + low `segments` — in 3D low-poly IS a style token like every other direction, not a geometry rewrite, unlike its 2D twin where every style shares one silhouette). One flip restyles every material-composed mesh; generated authoring preambles interpolate it.

knobDefs.label: Valley Pads

knobDefs.label: Zone Offsets
knobDefs.description: World-x offset per zone, in curriculum run order — the organism's stitching table. dx = zone left edge − the atom's local minimum x, so every import lands in its 26-unit slot.

knobDefs.label: Curve Mods Enabled
knobDefs.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.

knobDefs.label: Drift Regions
knobDefs.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.

knobDefs.label: Gravity
knobDefs.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it

knobDefs.label: Jump Strength
knobDefs.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)

knobDefs.label: Kill Y
knobDefs.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor

knobDefs.label: Max Fall Speed
knobDefs.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick

knobDefs.label: Move Speed
knobDefs.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1

knobDefs.label: Platforms
knobDefs.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body

knobDefs.label: Curve Skating
knobDefs.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.

knobDefs.label: Skate Curve
knobDefs.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.

knobDefs.label: Skate Max Gap
knobDefs.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).

knobDefs.label: Skate Snap
knobDefs.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps

knobDefs.label: Spawn Body
knobDefs.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box

knobDefs.label: Right Wall
knobDefs.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

knobDefs.label: Left Wall
knobDefs.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

knobDefs.label: Features
knobDefs.description: One row per collectible: id, center (x, y in world units), board-defined kind (star, boost, …), display glyph and message floated on pickup. collected is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.pickups — SET_FEATURES replaces it at runtime (boards that import collectibles), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected features survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact.

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact; generous values catch fly-through pickups.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED collects touched features; toggle to freeze the set as-is.

knobDefs.label: Hit Radius
knobDefs.description: Per-axis distance (world units) within which a patrol counts as touching the player; smaller values demand precise contact, larger values forgive.

knobDefs.label: Patrols
knobDefs.description: One row per patroller: id, the [x0, x1] beat it walks, its base y, its speed in units/s, and optionally waveAmp/wavePeriod for a vertical sine bob (waveAmp 0 = flat ping-pong). Current x/dir/t/cy/touching/hit are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.patrols — SET_PATROLS replaces it at runtime (boards that import patrols), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected patrols survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Player Spawn X
knobDefs.description: Player x assumed before the first BODY_MOVED arrives (match the body authority's spawn).

knobDefs.label: Player Spawn Y
knobDefs.description: Player y assumed before the first BODY_MOVED arrives.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the 33ms tick moves patrols and tests contact; toggle to freeze every patrol in place.

knobDefs.label: Checkpoints
knobDefs.description: Ordered along the run: when the player's x crosses atX the respawn point moves to (x, y). Must be sorted by atX ascending.

knobDefs.label: Invulnerability Window (ms)
knobDefs.description: Milliseconds after a accepted hit during which further DAMAGE is ignored, so a hazard overlapping the respawn can't chain-drain.

knobDefs.label: Max Lives
knobDefs.description: Lives seeded on INIT/RESTART; reaching zero fires GAME_OVER.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, DAMAGE and checkpoint crossings are processed; toggle to make the run harmless (practice mode).

knobDefs.label: Spawn X
knobDefs.description: Respawn x before any checkpoint is reached (match the body authority's spawn).

knobDefs.label: Spawn Y
knobDefs.description: Respawn y before any checkpoint is reached.

knobDefs.label: Doors
knobDefs.description: One row per gate: id, min-corner rect (x, y, width, height in world units) and the collected total that opens it. open/touching are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.doors — SET_DOORS replaces it at runtime (boards that import doors), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected doors survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach Margin
knobDefs.description: Extra world units padded around a closed door's rect when testing player contact (approximates the body's size).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, COLLECT opens doors and closed doors report contact; toggle to freeze every door as-is.

knobDefs.label: Locks
knobDefs.description: One row per winding lock: id, anchor (x, y in world units), ring radius, radial tolerance band, and revolutions required. swept/inside/unlocked are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.locks — SET_LOCKS replaces it at runtime (boards that import locks), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected locks survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED accumulates angular sweep and unlocks locks; toggle to freeze every lock as-is.

default.hint: hold still at the summit — slope 0
cross fast — v ∈ [7, 10] · your speed IS the slope

knobDefs.label: Gates
knobDefs.description: One row per velocity gate: id, min-corner rect (x, y, width, height in world units), the speed band [minSpeed, maxSpeed] that opens it, the hold required (dwellMs 0 = instant), the horizontal direction required (dir -1/0/+1), and an optional hint shown when denied. open/touching/denied/held/reported are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.gates — SET_VGATES replaces it at runtime (boards that import gates), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected gates survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach Margin
knobDefs.description: Extra world units padded around a closed gate's rect when testing player contact (approximates the body's size).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED tests every gate's band and opens/denies; toggle to freeze every gate as-is.

knobDefs.label: Pads
knobDefs.description: One row per floor pad: id, center (x, y in world units), and grp (0 = ungrouped, always live; N = live only while it is the lowest uncompleted group). lit is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.pads — SET_PADS replaces it at runtime (boards that import pads), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected pads survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (covers skating over the surface the pad sits on).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED lights touched live pads and reports group/set completion; toggle to freeze every pad as-is.

default.hint: the tail never ends, the area does
stay on the wave — the line clings near 0

knobDefs.label: Fills
knobDefs.description: One row per fill region: id, x-range (x0..x1 in world units), baseline the height is measured from, target area, rateMode (area | speed | ride — default area), optional hint, and the curve samples to interpolate. filled/frontier/reported are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.fills — SET_FILLS replaces it at runtime (boards that import fills), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected fills survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED paints every fill the player moves through; toggle to freeze every fill as-is.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED tracks the current zone and ages the card; toggle to freeze the card as-is.

knobDefs.label: TTL Ticks
knobDefs.description: BODY_MOVED ticks the card stays up after a zone crossing (≈ 4s at 30 moves/s) before it clears itself.

default.concept: x is a number you stand on
default.name: 1 · The Plain
default.objective: Catch 4 ★ — the line is your ground; mind the pits!

default.concept: slope = rise ÷ run = 1 ⁄ 2
default.name: 2 · The Ramp
default.objective: Climb the ramp — every step rises 1 for every 2 across. Catch 4 ★!

default.concept: y = x² ⁄ 16 — the bars are the function, sampled; the dashed mirror axis x = 0 pairs the floor pads — light one, light its mirror
default.name: 3 · The Valley
default.objective: Drop into the valley and climb its walls — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the summit is the local maximum — slope = 0 there
default.name: 4 · The Mountain
default.objective: Climb to the summit ★ — the highest point of the curve. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the curve never touches x = 3 — the dashed wall is an asymptote; the road fades as it climbs — trust the curve
default.name: 5 · The Pole
default.objective: The world breaks at x = 3 — jump the chasm and catch 4 ★!

default.concept: 1, 2, 4, 8 — each step costs double; the road fades ahead — trust the doubling
default.name: 6 · The Doubling
default.objective: The stair doubles: 1, 2, 4, 8. Find the springboard to the top ★!

default.concept: the bars are the area under the curve — a Riemann skyline
default.name: 7 · The Gallery
default.objective: Walk the skyline — the bars trace the curve. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: a shift: (x−4) slides the whole valley 4 steps right — same shape, new address; the ↑ pad carries the road's +k — ride it and the road rises to the high ledge
default.name: 8 · Shifts
default.objective: Skate the shifted valley — ride the ↑ pad: YOU lift the road to the high ledge — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the corner: slope is −½ on the left wall and +½ on the right — at x = 0 no single slope exists; the ⤢ pad retunes the right arm's a — dive the left wall for speed, then the steeper arm reaches the high shelf
default.name: 9 · Corner
default.objective: Skate down one wall — ride the ⤢ pad at the bottom: YOU tilt the road up to the shelf — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the inflection: steep, flat, steep — the slope's own slope flips sign at x = 0; the arrows lean toward the flat middle
default.name: 10 · Inflection
default.objective: Climb the S-curve — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the logarithm: a burst upward that flattens forever — doubling run backwards; left of x = −7 it does not exist; the road fades ahead — trust the slow climb
default.name: 11 · Log
default.objective: Leave the flatlands and climb the log — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: this ramp IS the valley's slope: far from the dashed line on the steep walls, crossing it where the valley bottoms out
default.name: 12 · Derivative
default.objective: Skate the valley's slope — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the shaded region grows as you run right — piling up strips of area is integration
default.name: 13 · Area
default.objective: Run right and watch the shaded area pile up — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: accumulation: the hill climbs fastest where the dashed bump is tallest — its height collects the bump
default.name: 14 · Accumulation
default.objective: Climb the accumulating hill — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: decay: every step right loses the same fraction — the slope stays −1/5 of the height (y′ = −y/5) — the dashed line is the floor y = 0.8 it sinks toward; the road fades ahead — trust the flattening
default.name: 15 · Decay
default.objective: Ride the decay down toward the floor — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the tail runs on forever and never touches 1 — yet the area under it stays finite: an improper integral
default.name: 16 · Tail
default.objective: Chase the tail toward y = 1 — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: each step is half the last: 1, ½, ¼, … — climb forever and never cross the ceiling 2; the last gap has no step — the ceiling is your answer, land on it
default.name: 17 · Series
default.objective: Climb the halving staircase — answer the limit to cross the final gap, then catch 5 ★!

default.concept: polynomials hug the wave: the line clings near 0, the cubic clings longer — infinitely many terms IS the wave
default.name: 18 · Taylor
default.objective: Skate the wave the polynomials are chasing — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: y = 0.6x + 3 has a removable hole at x = 2; the left and right branches meet at the same height, so the limit exists and the road can stitch
default.name: 19 · The Limit

default.concept: The secant slope between two points on a curve approaches the tangent slope as the points merge — average rate becomes instantaneous rate.
default.name: 20 · The Secant

default.concept: each step adds the same displacement ⟨1.6, 1⟩ — vectors add tip-to-tail
default.name: 21 · Vectors
default.objective: Walk the vector steps — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: The road is y = A·sin(B·(x − H)) + K. Touch the four glowing pads in order — A, H, B, K — to reshape the wave so every ★ is on a crest.
default.name: 22 · The Sine Wave

default.concept: slicing a hill z = f(x, y) at fixed heights gives contour lines — crowded contours mean a steep climb
default.name: 23 · Contours
default.objective: Climb the ridge across the contour levels — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the slope of z = 3 + x/4 + y/2 depends on direction: ∂z/∂x = ¼ under your feet, ∂z/∂y = ½ the dashed way
default.name: 24 · Partials
default.objective: Walk the x-slope — the dashed line is the y-slope. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the gradient ∇f points the steepest way up — the arrows always aim at the summit
default.name: 25 · Gradient
default.objective: Follow the gradient arrows to the summit — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the pass is the trail's minimum and the cross-trail's maximum at once — a saddle point; the arrows run downhill into the pass
default.name: 26 · Saddle
default.objective: Descend to the mountain pass and climb out — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: each column is one sum; adding the columns across is the second sum — ∬ f dA is a sum of sums
default.name: 27 · Volume
default.objective: Climb the columns of the double sum — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: a flat road plus sine harmonics builds a square-wave staircase — Fourier synthesis as terrain
default.name: 28 · Fourier

knobDefs.label: Zones
knobDefs.description: One row per world band: id, display name, the one-line concept, the zone's objective text, and the x-range (x0..x1) the band covers.

knobDefs.label: Fog Regions
knobDefs.description: One row per fogged world span: x-range (x0..x1) and lookAhead — how far past the player the road stays revealed while inside. Small values force prediction (blowups), large values suit slow tail lessons. Empty list = no fog anywhere.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED tracks the reveal horizon; toggle to freeze the fog where it is.

knobDefs.label: Choice Gates
knobDefs.description: One row per gate: id, gate center (x, y — y is the option-platform surface the judge tests against), the hint floated on a wrong answer, and the options: id, dx offset from the gate center, the label drawn above the platform, and correct. solved/chosen are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.choices — SET_GATES replaces it at runtime (boards that import gates), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected gates survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around an option platform's center when testing a landing (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around the gate's option plane when testing a landing (covers small hops onto the platform surface).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED judges option landings; toggle to freeze every gate as-is.

default.hint: +k — you lifted the road
a·f — the road steepened; only a fast dive climbs it

knobDefs.label: Coefficient Pads
knobDefs.description: One row per pad: id, center (x, y in world units), the mod applied to the road while inside x0..x1 (a scales slope+height, b compresses/stretch period, h shifts horizontally, k lifts), and the hint floated on apply, and hop (true = the board teleports the player onto the reshaped surface — use when the mod steps the road far from the pad; false = the skate snap carries the player, preserving speed). applied is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.coefPads — SET_PADS replaces it at runtime (boards that import pads), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected pads survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (covers riding the surface the pad sits on).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED applies touched pads; toggle to freeze every pad as-is.

knobDefs.label: Min Speed
knobDefs.description: Body speed (units/s, from BODY_MOVED) below which no dot is appended, so a resting body doesn't pile dots on one spot.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED appends trail dots; toggle to freeze the trail (existing dots still age out).

knobDefs.label: Trail Ttl (ms)
knobDefs.description: Milliseconds a trail dot lives; at a 33ms move cadence ~600ms keeps the last eighteen positions. The ttl is also the natural length cap — no separate limit needed.

knobDefs.label: Curve
knobDefs.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) of the graph being ridden — the same table the body skates and the canvas draws, so the readout matches what is underfoot. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.curve — SET_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the probe derives the readout off BODY_MOVED; toggle to freeze it (the board hides the tangent overlays when probing goes stale).

knobDefs.label: Triangle Run
knobDefs.description: Horizontal leg of the rise-over-run triangle; the vertical leg is slope × triRun, so triRun = 1 reads the slope directly.

knobDefs.label: Tangent Window
knobDefs.description: Half-length (world units along the tangent) of the tangent segment and of the glow sample window around the contact point.

knobDefs.label: Auto Show
knobDefs.description: When true the tutorial opens on INIT for this run; when false it stays hidden until SHOW.

knobDefs.label: Preview trait
knobDefs.description: Trait rendered in the media position of the modal — the live, demo-driven preview of the mechanic (a bare game canvas, no shell chrome). '@trait.TutorialEmptyPreview' leaves the slot blank. Override with '@trait.<TraitName>' to show a board's live frame.

default.body: ← → or A / D to run · Space, W or ↑ to jump. Pits cost a life — run the whole line!
default.title: Run & jump

default.body: Land on a curve and riya rides the function itself — downhill speeds you up, uphill slows you down. Jump to kick free.
default.title: Skate the graphs

default.body: Collect ★ — glowing doors open at 20, 50 and 80. Dodge the ✖ bugs and grab 🚩 checkpoints: three lives only.
default.title: Stars, doors & bugs

knobDefs.label: Steps
knobDefs.description: One row per tutorial page: title, one line of body copy, and an optional demoId that plays a scripted live demo (std-tutorial-autodemo) for the mechanic being taught.

knobDefs.label: Scripts
knobDefs.description: Named cue scripts keyed by the tutorial step's demoId; each cue fires its event after `at` milliseconds of the demo clock.

knobDefs.label: Player Vector Arrow Offset Y
knobDefs.description: World units above riya's center where the velocity arrow originates.

knobDefs.label: Player Vector Arrow Scale
knobDefs.description: Scale factor for riya's live velocity vector arrow, matching the standalone vector world.

knobDefs.label: Camera Lead
knobDefs.description: How far ahead of riya (toward her facing) the follow camera centers, in world units.

knobDefs.label: Checkpoint Color
knobDefs.description: Marker color for the 🚩 checkpoint flags (success green, both themes).

knobDefs.label: Checkpoints
knobDefs.description: One checkpoint per zone entry (mirrors OwLives.checkpoints); rendered as 🚩 flags and consumed by the lives authority as respawn points.

knobDefs.label: Equation Color
knobDefs.description: Color of the transient equation burst fired when a skate engages (and of telemetry text).

knobDefs.label: Door Color
knobDefs.description: Bar and lock-label color for closed star doors (amber; the bar disappears when the door opens).

knobDefs.label: FX Hit Puff Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for hit / info puffs.

knobDefs.label: FX Presets
knobDefs.description: Look table for world-space particle effects.

knobDefs.label: FX Star Burst Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for star-collect bursts.

knobDefs.label: FX Unlock Sparkle Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for unlock sparkles.

knobDefs.label: Field Vectors
knobDefs.description: Static arrow fields from the multivariable zones (vector steps, partials, gradient field, saddle trails, volume slabs), offset into world coordinates.

knobDefs.label: Modded Road Color
knobDefs.description: Color of the reshaped road segment drawn once a coefficient pad applies (bright yellow — the lifted/tilted surface reads as the player's own edit).

knobDefs.label: Patrol Color
knobDefs.description: Marker color for the ✖ patrol bugs (danger red, both themes).

knobDefs.label: Player Sprite Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + SpriteSheetAtlas for riya. Set to {} to fall back to the colored dot.

knobDefs.label: Reach Radius
knobDefs.description: A star's own radius (world units) — the gameTick collects a star when it overlaps riya's painted sprite box, extended by this padding.

knobDefs.label: Riya Color
knobDefs.description: Core marker color for riya the dot (brand red — legible on dark and light themes).

knobDefs.label: Riya Halo Color
knobDefs.description: Soft halo ring under riya's core dot (8-digit hex with alpha).

knobDefs.label: Riya Sprite Height
knobDefs.description: World-unit height of the riya sprite.

knobDefs.label: Riya Sprite Width
knobDefs.description: World-unit width of the riya sprite (scaled by the math-canvas x-axis pixel scale).

knobDefs.label: Show Telemetry
knobDefs.description: When true, draws a compact x/y/v readout on the canvas near riya (teaching/debug aid).

knobDefs.label: Spawn X
knobDefs.description: World x riya starts at (must match the lives authority's spawnX).

knobDefs.label: Spawn Y
knobDefs.description: World y riya starts at.

knobDefs.label: Star Halo Color
knobDefs.description: Soft glow ring under each uncollected star (8-digit hex with alpha).

knobDefs.label: Terrain Color
knobDefs.description: Bar color for the ground/platform/bridge bars.

knobDefs.label: Trail Color
knobDefs.description: Comet-trail dot color (8-digit hex with alpha); dots fade out by ttl via std-fx-trail.

knobDefs.label: View Half Width
knobDefs.description: Half the visible math window's width in world units — the camera clamps to [viewHalfWidth, worldWidth − viewHalfWidth].

knobDefs.label: World Name
knobDefs.description: Display name shown in the in-flow top row as "riya · <worldName>".

knobDefs.label: World Width
knobDefs.description: Right edge of the world in math units (the final zone's exit); the camera and the body clamp against it.

knobDefs.label: Y Max
knobDefs.description: Top edge of the fixed vertical window (covers every zone's tallest content).

knobDefs.label: Y Min
knobDefs.description: Bottom edge of the fixed vertical window (pit depth stays visible).

knobDefs.label: Zone Label Color
knobDefs.description: Color of the zone name markers floating at each zone's start.

knobDefs.label: Zone Label Y
knobDefs.description: Height of the zone name markers (near the top of the fixed vertical window).

knobDefs.label: Zones
knobDefs.description: The twenty-eight curriculum zones in run order: world-x span and family band color for the canvas region wash. Display names/concepts live on the zone-card config; equations and guides import from the atoms (entity.zoneMeta).

knobDefs.label: Body content tree
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr for the tutorial preview frame: a bare math-canvas following the demo-driven body position, seeded from the board's static terrain/curves/stars.

knobDefs.label: Gravity
knobDefs.description: Downward acceleration for the preview jump arc (world units/sec²), matching the play body.

knobDefs.label: Ground Y
knobDefs.description: Marker rest height in the preview (spawn ground top + marker offset); the preview jump arc lands here.

knobDefs.label: Canvas Height
knobDefs.description: math-canvas display height in px for the tutorial preview frame.

knobDefs.label: Jump Strength
knobDefs.description: Initial vertical velocity of the preview jump (world units/sec), matching the play body.

knobDefs.label: Move Speed
knobDefs.description: Horizontal run speed of the demo-driven preview mirror (world units/sec), matching the play canvas.

knobDefs.label: Preview Player Sprite Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + SpriteSheetAtlas for the live tutorial preview. Set to {} to fall back to the colored dot.

knobDefs.label: Riya Color
knobDefs.description: Core marker color for riya in the preview.

knobDefs.label: Riya Halo Color
knobDefs.description: Soft halo ring under riya in the preview.

knobDefs.label: Preview Riya Sprite Height
knobDefs.description: World-unit height of the preview riya sprite.

knobDefs.label: Preview Riya Sprite Width
knobDefs.description: World-unit width of the preview riya sprite.

knobDefs.label: Star Color
knobDefs.description: Marker color for uncollected stars in the preview.

knobDefs.label: Star Halo Color
knobDefs.description: Soft glow ring under each star in the preview.

knobDefs.label: Terrain Color
knobDefs.description: Bar color for ground/platform bars in the preview.

knobDefs.label: View Half Width
knobDefs.description: Half the visible preview window in world units, matching the play canvas.

knobDefs.label: Canvas Width
knobDefs.description: math-canvas display width in px for the tutorial preview frame.

knobDefs.label: World Width
knobDefs.description: Right edge of the world; the preview camera clamps against it.

knobDefs.label: Y Max
knobDefs.description: Top edge of the preview window.

knobDefs.description: Bottom edge of the preview window.
